video_goal: Demonstrate how to endorse a paper check and deposit it using the Chase Mobile app's camera capture feature.
single_prompt: An over-the-shoulder view shows a hand tapping the blue Chase Mobile app icon on a black smartphone displaying the Chase Mobile app, a standard physical paper check, and a blue ink pen. The view shifts to a close-up as a hand places the physical paper check face-down on a dark, flat wooden surface under bright, even overhead indoor lighting. Transitioning back to a screen capture, a finger taps the 'Amount' field and types in the check's numerical value using the on-screen keypad. The finger then taps the 'Front' camera icon button. The camera moves to a first-person view as the smartphone is held over the front of the check, aligning the paper within the green rectangular guide. In a first-person view, the smartphone is held over the back of the check, aligning the signature within the on-screen green rectangular guide. A screen capture reveals the camera auto-capturing the back of the check, showing the cropped preview image next to the front image. A finger scrolls down the review screen and taps the solid blue 'Deposit' button at the bottom. Finally, a green checkmark appears on the screen with the text 'Deposit received'.
